exercises.prompt: Identify the grammatical role and case of المَسْجِدِ in بَابُ المَسْجِدِ مَفْتُوحٌ.
choices: Muḍāf ilayh — Genitive (majrūr) marked by kasrah
exercises.answer: Muḍāf ilayh — Genitive (majrūr) marked by kasrah
exercises.explanation: المَسْجِدِ is the second term of the iḍāfah (al-muḍāf ilayh), which is always in the genitive case.

feedback.rule: The muḍāf ilayh is strictly genitive (majrūr).

exercises.prompt: Select the correct form of كِتَابَانِ ('two books') when annexed as muḍāf: 'the two books of the student'.
exercises.explanation: A dual muḍāf drops its final nūn (كِتَابَانِ → كِتَابَا) and never takes the definite article (الـ).

feedback.rule: Duals and sound masculine plurals drop final nūn when serving as muḍāf.
feedback.commonError: Keeping the nūn (كِتَابَانِ الطَّالِبِ) or adding the definite article (الكِتَابَا).

exercises.prompt: Arrange the words to form: 'The door of the mosque is open.'
exercises.explanation: The iḍāfah بَابُ المَسْجِدِ forms a single definite mubtadaʾ, followed by the indefinite khabar مَفْتُوحٌ.
